The weekly ranking is determined based on the representative score within the current tier received from the placement test. Among users who meet the top 20% per tier or the promotion readiness criteria to the next tier for two consecutive weeks, at least 1 and up to 5 users are selected as promotion candidates. In the order of the tier candidates below, compare their representative scores with the lower ranks of the next tier above; if the candidate has a better score, exchange the two users' tier, intra-tier ranking, and GP. In the session where representative records are selected, only the records chosen within the designated period are applied.

Opponents matched in the past 7 days are excluded from invitations, and only one unestablished reservation per target tier is allowed at a time. Direct cancellations before the match is established are free.

The 1-hour priority is not a hard block, and the Revenge battle is excluded from the daily cap and 72-hour priority tally count.
The unranked general battle staked payback score is fixed at 1 point.

translations.Unranked 일반 쟁탈전은 같은 티어 또는 바로 위 티어 조합에서만: Unranked regular raids can only be created at the same tier or in combinations of the immediately higher tier.
translations.Unranked 일반 쟁탈전의 상대는 자동으로 정해집니다. 먼저 공격자와: Opponents in Unranked General Contests are determined automatically. First, eligible candidates are searched within the same tier as the attacker but with a higher internal ranking than the attacker. Only if no candidates are found, the search expands one tier above. Among the candidate group, opponents are selected to distribute defensive opportunities fairly. If automatic defense matches are not started 5 times, the user will be excluded from the auto-defense candidates, but the learning day deduction will continue, and if one attack match that can participate is normally completed, the accumulation resets and automatic defense is reactivated. One user can only have one unsettled official match at a time. Both Unranked and Ranked block new matching, invite acceptance, revenge match requests, preparation, and start from Sunday 14:00, and from 15:00 until Monday 00:00, Arena rank changes and public final comprehensive rankings are frozen.

For example, entering with 30 points starts with 3 days by combining 1 carryover day and 2 bonus days. The entry bonus can only be received once per Unranked usage cycle.
translations.Unranked 페이백 자격은 29일 이용 주기 중 서로 다른 한국 날짜: Unranked payback eligibility requires that during the 29-day usage cycle, the user must have normally submitted all 5 answers and required solving proofs as an attacker in Unranked General Contests or revenge matches on 15 different Korean dates, meeting both the payback score of 30 or more and passing the fairness review. Starting an attack alone is not recognized, and the match outcome does not matter. Even if normally submitted multiple times in one day, attack attendance counts as one day. translations.Unranked에는 이 제한을 적용하지 않습니다. Ranked의 마스터: This restriction does not apply to Unranked. Masters and above in Ranked check the current active ranker scale and upper rankings together.

translations.Unranked에서는 상대 개인과 목표 티어를 고르지 않습니다. 먼저 같: In Unranked, you do not choose individual opponents or target tiers. First, eligible candidates with a higher rank than you are sought within the same tier, and only if no candidates exist is the range expanded one tier higher. It does not go more than two tiers above, and Challengers target only those Challenger-ranked players ranked higher than themselves. Users who settled a defensive match within the last hour are placed lower if other candidates exist; if all candidates are in the same state, matching is not blocked. Next, users with fewer general contention defense matches in the last 72 hours are prioritized, and if tied, the user whose last defensive assignment was the longest ago is matched first. Only if all these times are equal is the selection random, and rematches are excluded from this calculation.
translations.Unranked와 Ranked 모두 소속과 무관한 통합 티어 순위에서 G: Both Unranked and Ranked display GP and rank within the tier on an integrated tier ranking independent of affiliation. The final overall ranking is maintained integrating all users.
translations.Unranked와 Ranked 모두 일요일 14:00부터 새 경기 시작을: Both Unranked and Ranked block new matches from Sunday 14:00, and only ongoing matches can be completed until 15:00.
translations.Unranked와 Ranked 모두 일요일 14:00부터 새 경기 신청·: In both Unranked and Ranked, new match applications, invitation acceptance, rematch applications, preparation, and start are blocked from Sunday 14:00. Matches starting before 14:00 must be completed by 15:00 with the 10-minute-per-question rule applied. Both divisions lock match writing and settlement from 15:00 until Monday 00:00, fixing the Arena rankings and publicly available final overall ranking. During this time, provisional results for the Matths weekly official mock exam of normal users are calculated and published once at 00:00 on Monday.
Unranked and Ranked rankings can both be viewed.
translations.Unranked와 Ranked는 같은 문제·증거·승패 기준을 사용하지만: Unranked and Ranked use the same problem, evidence, and win/loss criteria, but the challenge targets, deposit ledger (Unranked payback score · Ranked study days), multiple match settlement, and usage termination rules are different.
translations.Unranked와 Ranked는 별도 카탈로그로 관리합니다. 같은 숫자의: Unranked and Ranked are managed as separate catalogs.
